transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because my sleep is really broken up. I get off my overnight shift and just lie there awake, and then when I finally do fall asleep, I wake up scared. It feels like I never really rested at all.
When you wake up scared, do you remember having vivid or frightening dreams?
I don’t really remember specific dreams. I just wake up scared, and then I can’t settle back down. It’s like the sleep doesn’t help at all.
Do your sleep difficulties improve on your days off when you are not working overnight?
No, not really. Even when I’m off, I still lie awake for a long time, and if I do fall asleep I wake up scared. I don’t feel rested either way.
Do you ever experience sudden rushes of intense fear or anxiety during the day when you are awake?
I’m not sure. I feel on edge a lot, but I haven’t really noticed sudden rushes like that during the day.
Have you ever experienced or witnessed a traumatic event where your life was in danger or you felt severely threatened?
No, I don’t think so. Nothing like that comes to mind.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different everyday things, like work, family, or health?
I’m not sure. I do worry sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed it being about lots of different things all the time.
Has anyone ever told you that you sit up, scream, or thrash around in bed during these episodes?
No, I don’t think anyone’s told me I scream or thrash around. I just wake up scared sometimes, and my sleep is really broken up.
How long have you been having these problems with your sleep?
About a year and two months. It started after my agency switched me to rotating overnight shifts and gave me extra paperwork.
Do you struggle with overwhelming sleepiness or finding it hard to stay awake during your waking or working hours?
Yeah. After an overnight shift, I can’t fall asleep when I get home, and then when I finally do, I keep waking up scared. I feel like I never really rested, so it’s hard to stay awake sometimes.
